# `aitbc coin-requests execute`

Execute an approved coin transfer request by submitting a signed transaction.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc coin-requests execute [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--request-id` | text | — | yes | The Request id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc coin-requests execute --request-id <request_id>
```
